name: Spooky Bingo
ogImageAlt: Spooky Bingo: a bingo board with pumpkin-marked numbers, a ghost and a jack-o'-lantern under a full moon

description.board: A Halloween bingo board for the classroom: draw the numbers 1 to 99 with spooky sounds and animations, then play English challenges for kids aged 7 to 10.
description.cards: Printable Spooky Bingo cards: 24 unique Halloween tombola cards on A4 sheets, ready to print and cut for the classroom.
description.answers: The answers to every Spooky Bingo English challenge, for the host.
